results.title: Aligning Security Compliance and DevOps: A Longitudinal Study
results.content: The specific goals of this study were: (A) determine RefA ’s accuracy in representing security compliance practices and artefacts, (B) determine subjects perception about RefA, and (C) explore the applicability of RefA-AP and RefA-AR for security compliance assessment in DevOps contexts. With the application of RefA-based assessment utilities, RefA-AP and RefA-MR, we learned that security compliance assessments: (i) can be performed more frequently than regular yearly/quarterly approaches, (ii) can fit within a two-week iterations, (iii) can produce incremental results either per DevOps phase or RefA practice area and (iv) can be performed by DevOps team members with limited support from security experts, if they have the necessary tools. These studies enabled the identification of relevant challenges and needs in the field of security compliance (SC) within agile development and DevOps. We framed the requirements and evaluation stage of our framework to enable SC assessments of DevOps processes, resulting in the reference architecture for security-compliant DevOps RefA and the related assessments utilities RefA-AP and RefA-AR.
